id: 22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机更换直流电源（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/22_Replace the DC Power Supply for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
points.K2: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
points.K10: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
points.K11: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
points.K13: 接线与参考图完全一致

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带脚轮的激光焊接机旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine in a workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换直流电源。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换直流电源

shots.scene: 闪电、手套、端子、眼镜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lightning bolt, an insulated glove, a pair of wire terminals, and laser safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 高压、绝缘、接线、激光，一个都不能马虎。

shots.scene: 阿杰闻了闻焊接机散热口，皱起眉头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sniffs near the vent of the laser welding machine and frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰闻到焊接机有股焦糊味。

shots.scene: 阿杰耸耸肩，转身想继续开机干活
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and reaches for the power switch to keep working.
shots.narration: 他想：还能开机，接着用吧。

shots.scene: 小研按住他的手，摇头，指向空白报修单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops his hand, shakes her head and points at a blank repair request form.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先停机，马上报修。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现焦糊味、发烫、异响、鼓包四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the panda mascot float four icons: a smoke wisp, a heat wave symbol, a sound wave, and a swollen box.
shots.narration: 焦糊味、外壳发烫、异响，都是危险信号。

shots.scene: 阿杰关机拔掉插头，在空白记录本上写下现象
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off and unplugs the machine, then writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 发现异常就停机断电，记下现象。

shots.scene: 王老师接过报修单，打电话联系老李
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator takes the blank repair form and makes a phone call to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，安排专业维修。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 黄黑条纹的警示卡，中间是闪电和激光三角标志
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with yellow and black stripes, showing an electric shock warning sign and a laser warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 这台设备内部有高压，还有强激光。
overlay: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 触电和烧伤图标并排，下面一个惊叹号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electric shock and a burned hand side by side with a large exclamation mark below. No people.
shots.narration: 处理不当，可能触电、烧伤。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 阿杰拿螺丝刀伸向机箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student reaching toward a machine cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 非专业人员，严禁擅自拆机。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 老李胸前挂空白工作证，提着工具箱到场
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives with a toolbox, wearing a blank work badge.
shots.narration: 换电源由专业维修人员来做。

shots.section_title: 仅限专业人员，内有高压和强激光
shots.scene: 老李关闭焊接机电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns off the main power switch of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 动手前，一定先断电。

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 电源模块图标里闪着电，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power supply module with a small lightning symbol inside and an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后，电源里还可能残留高压。
overlay: 残余高压，等够时间再碰

shots.section_title: 残余高压，等够时间再碰
shots.scene: 老李看着空白说明书，再看手表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads a blank service manual and then checks his watch.
shots.narration: 按说明书规定的时间等待，再去触碰。

shots.scene: 老李戴上一双绝缘手套，检查手指部位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on a pair of thick insulated rubber gloves and checks the fingers.
shots.narration: 全过程都要戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 徒手接触端子的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching wire terminals, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能图方便，摘了手套徒手拆线。

shots.scene: 老李在机器前铺开一块绝缘垫，站上去
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unrolls a rubber insulating mat in front of the machine and steps onto it.
shots.narration: 维修时站在绝缘垫上。

shots.scene: 地面一滩水和湿鞋图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a puddle of water on the floor and a wet shoe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 地面有水、鞋子潮湿，都不能作业。

shots.scene: 小研用拖把把地面擦干，旁边放好黄色警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student mops the floor dry and sets a yellow wet floor caution sign aside.
shots.narration: 先把地面清理干燥，再开始。

shots.scene: 台面上两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手和新电源
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a workbench with two cross-head screwdrivers, a hex wrench and a new metal-cased power supply module with a honeycomb vent. No people.
shots.narration: 备好两把十字螺丝刀、内六角扳手和新电源。

shots.scene: 老李拔下电源插头，再拔下其他线缆和气管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls out the power plug, then disconnects the other cables and the gas hose from the machine.
shots.narration: 关机后拔掉电源插头和全部线缆。

shots.scene: 老李把四个脚轮的锁扣依次踩下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake levers of all four caster wheels one by one.
shots.narration: 锁住四个脚轮，机器不会滑动。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角扳手松开把手螺丝，取下把手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens the handle screws with the hex wrench and lifts the handles off.
shots.narration: 松开前后把手的八颗螺丝，取下把手。

shots.scene: 老李拆下左盖顶部螺丝，取下盖板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the top screw of the left side cover and lifts the cover away.
shots.narration: 拆下左盖螺丝，取下左侧盖板。

shots.scene: 机内一块透明塑料罩盖着电源接线端子
shots.prompt_en: Inside the opened machine, a clear plastic shield covers the terminal block of a power supply module. No people.
shots.narration: 电源接线端子前，有一块透明防护罩。

shots.scene: 戴手套的老李取下透明罩，逐根拆下端子线
shots.prompt_en: Wearing insulated gloves, the facility engineer removes the clear shield and unscrews the wire terminals one by one.
shots.narration: 取下防护罩，再拆电源一侧的接线。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀同时碰到两个端子，冒出火花，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal screwdriver touching two terminals at once with a spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工具同时碰到两个端子，就会短路打火。

shots.scene: 拆下的线头用绝缘胶带包好，彼此分开
shots.prompt_en: Disconnected wire ends are wrapped in insulating tape and kept apart from each other. No people.
shots.narration: 拆下的线头包好绝缘，彼此分开。

shots.scene: 老李手持一把柄部绝缘的螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a screwdriver with a fully insulated handle and shaft.
shots.narration: 用带绝缘柄的工具，一次只动一根线。

shots.section_title: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
shots.scene: 老李一只手托住电源底部，另一只手拧最后一颗螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer supports the bottom of the power supply with one hand while removing the last screw with the other.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗螺丝时，用手托住电源。
overlay: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住

shots.section_title: 拆最后一颗螺丝要托住
shots.scene: 电源掉落砸到电路板的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power supply module falling onto a circuit board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止电源掉下来，砸坏下方元件。

shots.scene: 新旧两个电源并排，铭牌用箭头对照
shots.prompt_en: Old and new power supply modules side by side with arrows comparing their blank rating plates. No people.
shots.narration: 装之前，核对新电源的规格和型号。

shots.scene: 输出电压、功率两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a voltage meter symbol and a power symbol, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 输出电压、功率要和原件一致。

shots.scene: 一个外形相似但不同的电源被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A similar-looking but different power supply module is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 外形差不多的电源，不能随便代替。

shots.section_title: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
shots.scene: 老李把新电源放进机内，对准螺丝孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer places the new power supply into the machine and lines it up with the screw holes.
shots.narration: 把新电源放到原来的位置。
overlay: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝

shots.section_title: 装新电源，拧紧四颗螺丝
shots.scene: 老李拧紧四颗固定螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens four mounting screws on the new power supply.
shots.narration: 拧紧四颗固定螺丝。

shots.section_title: 接线与参考图完全一致
shots.scene: 老李一边看平板上的空白接线示意图，一边接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at a simple wiring diagram on a tablet made only of lines and colored dots, then connects the wires.
shots.narration: 接线时，对照参考图一根一根接。
overlay: 接线与参考图完全一致

shots.section_title: 接线与参考图完全一致
shots.scene: 颜色和位置对应的线头图标打勾，接反的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: wires matched to terminals by color with a green check, and swapped wires with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 位置、颜色都要和参考图完全一致。

shots.scene: 老李把透明防护罩装回端子前方
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fits the clear plastic shield back over the terminal block.
shots.narration: 接好线，装回透明防护罩。

shots.scene: 透明罩挡住手指伸向端子的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a clear shield blocking a finger from reaching live terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 它能防止手指和工具碰到带电端子。

shots.scene: 盖板挂钩对准机架销钉，老李推入并拧螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer aligns three hooks on the side cover with three pegs on the frame, pushes it in and tightens the screw.
shots.narration: 三个挂钩对准三个销钉，推入左盖拧紧。

shots.scene: 老李装回两侧把手，用内六角扳手拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the handles on both sides and tightens them with the hex wrench.
shots.narration: 两侧把手装回，螺丝全部拧紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一道虚线光束示意图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a diagram where an invisible beam is drawn as a dashed line toward an eye icon.
shots.narration: 这类激光肉眼看不见，修好试机更要小心。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标前没有光，却出现受伤的星形
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with no visible light in front of it, yet a small injury star appears on it. No people.
shots.narration: 看不见光，不等于没有危险。

shots.scene: 门上贴着激光警告标志，门外亮着工作指示灯
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign on a closed workshop door with a lit red indicator lamp above it. No people.
shots.narration: 试焊在受控区域进行，门口有警示。

shots.scene: 老李戴好激光防护眼镜，阿杰在区域外
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears laser safety goggles at the welding bench while the young male student stays outside the area.
shots.narration: 戴好防护眼镜，按现行国家标准执行。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the closed machine with step icons floating behind: a smoke wisp, a rubber mat, wrapped wire ends and goggles.
shots.narration: 异常就报修，绝缘不马虎，接线对图纸。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老李点头致谢
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and thanks the facility engineer beside the repaired machine.
shots.narration: 阿杰记住了：闻到焦味先停机。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in the workshop.
shots.narration: 高压面前不逞能。下次见！
